admission.justification: A process-wide memo of variable Git observations can retain large reference maps and alternate witnesses after their native caller has finished.

applicability: Packed-reference parsing and variable Git object census observations under native request ownership.
conditions: Reuse is limited to the exact observed file identity or object witness while the request is active.
Changed or unavailable observations take the current read path.
exclusions: The dashboard retains its existing process-owned bounded reuse.

evidence: bug-r18-W2-expanded-evidence.md, L18-F04, both large-input and dashboard witness checks.
handoff.path: BUG-L18 W2 affected knowledge and initial history

statement: Git packed references and variable object-store witnesses used by a native tool are shared within its request lifetime.
